summary: Iteration 19 — Admin analytics endpoint + dashboard tabs fully validated. Backend 6/6 pytest pass, frontend all 6 KPI cards + 8 charts render with SVG content, tabs (analytics/users) switch correctly, user list + search + reset-password modal + logout all regression-clean. Confirmed yashwork1303@gmail.com has exactly 1 project via /api/admin/users. Payload contract verified: kpis (6 fields), new_users_daily (30), projects_daily (30), status_distribution, step_funnel (5, labels Step 1..5), cycle_time_points, top_users, share_funnel (4, stages Shared/Reviewed/Accepted/Rejected), share_accept_rate, activity_heatmap (7 days Sun..Sat × 24 hours), generated_at. Access control confirmed: 404 for anonymous, 404 for authenticated non-admin. Existing routes /api/projects list + create + GET-by-id all still work.

issues: Recharts logs benign 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings for ResponsiveContainer during initial layout tick — charts still render correctly with full SVG content (svg_child_count 50–748 per chart). Non-blocking, but noisy in console. Consider setting an explicit min-height on the ResponsiveContainer parent or wrapping in a mounted-guard to silence.

action_items: Optional: silence recharts ResponsiveContainer width/height warnings by giving parent Card body an explicit min-height (currently uses inline 'height' prop which is fine — the warning is a false positive from recharts during initial paint measuring), no functional impact.
iter_17 stale assertion note still holds from previous iteration (DEFAULT_MODEL == haiku will fail if that file is executed) — no change here.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_analytics endpoint (line 476) is ~155 lines — reasonable, but could be extracted into an admin_analytics_service module for readability once more analytics land.
activity_heatmap py_to_sun inverse lookup uses a list comprehension per iteration; trivial cost but a static reversed dict would be clearer: sun_to_py = {0:6, 1:0, 2:1, ...}.

cycle_time_points and activity_heatmap have hardcoded find limits (500 and 5000) — for a growing project table these will silently truncate. Consider aggregation pipelines or explicit UI-side sampling once thresholds are approached.

top_users query filters owner_user_id existence but ignores legacy creator_email-only projects; that is a small under-count for pre-pivot data. Not a bug given the auth pivot cleanup path, but worth noting.
share_accept_rate divides accepted / (accepted+rejected). If 'reviewed' is a distinct share_status value in the future, that base will need to change.
AdminAnalytics.jsx (532 lines) is under the 700-line ceiling but approaching it — extracting Kpi/Card/Heatmap into a components file would keep it maintainable.
All new interactive/informational elements carry data-testid — good.
COLORS constant and unit props keep the palette centralized — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all KPIs + charts render, tabs work, regression clean

test_credentials: Admin: support@use-bracket.com / Bracket@123. Non-admin: fresh OTP user via /api/auth/otp/request (dev_code returned in preview).
seed_data_creation: Test-scoped project created and immediately deleted via authenticated flow. No persistent test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login uses POST /api/auth/login (NOT /api/admin/login — the latter is only a frontend route). /api/admin/analytics returns 404 for anon & non-admins by design. Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits a benign width/height=-1 warning on first paint that is safe to ignore — DO NOT treat it as a chart-render failure; check for actual svg presence + child count instead.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration was a definitive verification pass on newly built analytics; no defects surfaced.
